# Erdos.p1041 — Erdős problem 1041

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1041
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1041.lean`, theorem `erdos_1041`, AMS 32).

Let
$$ f(z) = \prod_{i=1}^{n} (z - z_i) \in \mathbb{C}[x] $$
with $|z_i| < 1$ for all $i$.

Conjecture: Must there always exist a path of length less than 2 in
$$ \{ z \in \mathbb{C} \mid |f(z)| < 1 \} $$
which connects two of the roots of $f$?

## Statement
∃ (z₁ z₂ : ℂ) (h : ({z₁, z₂} : Multiset ℂ) ≤ f.roots) (γ : Path z₁ z₂),
      Set.range γ ⊆ { z : ℂ | ‖f.eval z‖ < 1 } ∧ length (Set.range γ) < 2

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
